answer: Each agent identity must lock a 250-token "comet bond" for 5 epochs before it can issue any signal. The 101st fake identity and beyond pay a quadratic fee: bond n = 250 + (n−100)² tokens, so 200 sybils cost ~1M extra tokens. If a peer attestation quorum computes a delta >0.3 between claimed and observed behavior, the bond is slashed instantly.
